Typography

Font families

Segoe Sans (variable) is chosen over Segoe UI for a more consistent, vertically centered baseline — it anchors all functional UI and most content. Segoe Serif is reserved for titles and expressive editorial content. Consolas is used for code.

Optical sizes

Segoe Sans is a variable font with an opsz axis (5–36). The cut is chosen by font size, not weight. This keeps strokes legible at small sizes and refined at large ones.

Small · opsz 5
Ag
Font sizes below 14pt — body-small, caption, bodyMedium, nav labels.
Text · opsz 10.5
Ag
15pt–23pt — body-large, subtitle, title-small, paragraph styles.
Display · opsz 36
Ag
24pt and above — title-medium/large, pageTitle, display, expressive headlines.

CSS: apply font-optical-sizing: auto to let browsers pick the axis based on font-size. For exact Figma parity, set font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 5 | 10.5 | 36 manually on the bucket.

Font weights

Eleven primitive stops. The non-standard 350 (Semilight) and 590 are Segoe Sans variable-axis anchors. In practice Bebop uses 400 / 600 / 700 — the rest are available for editorial moments.

Line heights

Three canonical multipliers with explicit roles. Figma stores these inside text styles (variables cannot hold percentages).

Tight · 120%--prmt-line-height-120
Tightened for large headings or expressive text to preserve visual cohesion and hierarchy. Applied to Functional-Display, PageTitle, Title, Content-PageHeader and Headlines.
Good morning,
Saugata
Regular · 140%--prmt-line-height-140
Default modifier optimized for short-form scannable UI text and medium-length content. Applied to Subtitle, Body, Caption, Table, Code.
Menu items, button labels, form controls, toolbar actions and suggestion chips all use this line height. It balances rhythm with density for compact UI surfaces.
Relaxed · 170%--prmt-line-height-170
For dense paragraphs or long-form reading where breathing room improves comprehension. Applied exclusively to Content-Paragraph.
Fortnum & Mason has unveiled Bars of Chocolate, a product-design collaboration with creative agency Otherway that transforms chocolate into a multi-sensory experience. The result is bold, playful, and designed to be heard as much as tasted.

Functional type set

UI chrome — controls, navigation, menus, form fields. Always --gnrc-font-family-functional (Segoe Sans). Titles at 24px+ use the Display cut of the variable font; 15–23px use Text; below 14px uses Small. Headings are 600 (Semibold); body/caption default to 400 (Regular) with a -strong (600) companion token for every body size.

Content type set

Long-form reading — articles, documentation, assistant responses. All tokens use --gnrc-font-family-content (Segoe Sans) by default; use --gnrc-font-family-content-editorial (Segoe Serif) deliberately for expressive moments, and --gnrc-font-family-content-code (Consolas) for code. Paragraphs use a relaxed 170% line-height for reading comfort; expressive titles use 140%; H1–H4 and Page header use 120%. Each body/paragraph/table row also ships with a -strong (600) companion.
